title: Required applications failing on a significant share of devices

maxFailPct.text: Share of targets failing before the package is treated as broken

report.title: {Items.Count} required {Plural(Items.Count, 'application is', 'applications are')} failing on more than {params.maxFailPct}% of devices

messages.businessImpact: Users do not have software the organisation has decided they need, and every failure is a potential service desk call that nobody has raised yet.
remediation: Check the detection rule first, since a detection that never matches presents as a permanent failure.
Then check requirements and dependencies, and whether the installer needs a context the assignment does not give it.
messages.cannotSee: Counts come from Intune's install summary report, which can lag the devices by a day and counts devices rather than people. Where the report cannot be read this rule is skipped, because an application nobody counted is not one that failed nowhere.
